notes: All six pages are Common Crawl captures (CC-MAIN-2019-43, captured 2019-10-15/16) of the Columbia Business School Doctoral program 'Dissertations' pages filtered by year (2003-2008). Each entry gives a dissertation title, a byline 'Name, YEAR' and a 'Faculty Advisor' line; no placements, positions, degrees or departments are stated, so destination/position/degree are null and program is taken from the breadcrumb 'Programs » Doctoral » Dissertations'. yearMeaning is 'unstated' for every record: the page lists dissertations under a year selector without saying whether the year is the defense, deposit, or degree-conferral year. The integrator should treat it as a dissertation year, not as a verified graduation or placement year. Field/department per person is not given; it can only be inferred from the advisor and title (for example van Ryzin, Savin, Gallego, Federgruen and Fangruo Chen advisees are operations-related), which this proposal does not do. Pagination gaps: the 2003 capture shows '1 of 2' and the 2008 capture shows '1 of 3' with an 'Older items' link, so later result pages for those years were not captured and those years are incomplete here. The 2004-2007 captures show no pagination control. Name spellings are kept as written (for example 'Jorg Rocholl', 'Joern Meissner', 'Jeffrey A Robinson', 'Geraldine A Wu' without a period after the initial). The 2007 title for Thanavut Pornrojnangkool contains spacing artifacts ('Inform ation C ontents') copied as written. Entries for Ron Shalev, Chang-Yong Ha and Anat Keinan (2007) carry no abstract on the page, only title, byline and advisor.
